sourceDuties.HE_G9: The prepared excursion is compulsory for 7.3; measurement and identification with provided keys are retained. 6.3 links distribution, abiotic factors and thermoregulation, not directed adaptive change.
sourceDuties.HE_current: Q3.1 core includes carbon, qualitative species/factor capture; nitrogen, population models and quantitative capture add LK. Q4.1 is binding; Q4.2 is not globally binding, diversity/succession adds LK. Q3.2 and E.2 actual experiments and metabolic details remain distinct duties, not closed by the 20 ecology candidates.
sourceDuties.BY9: Own soil investigation, digital documentation, matter/energy flow, humus/mineralization over time, carbon atoms and soil/food risk chains are preserved.
sourceDuties.BY12_GA: Current GA title and process standards S8/B12 actually read; no historical EA alias used to rename the current course.
sourceDuties.BY13_GA: Ecology 4.1 includes own abiotic measurement, use of genuine field data for qualitative composition and lab-based ecological potency. Growth models are GA content; carbon cycle. Metabolic/chromatography duties in 3 remain separate.
sourceDuties.BY13_EA: EA adds quantitative field capture, nitrogen, reproductive strategies, Lotka-Volterra and capture-recapture. 3.2 independently planned enzyme experiments include pH; no paper/fictitious data substitute or whole section closure.
